title: NVLink port thermal degradation on H100 node, training cost-per-token spikes 271%
alert:
ALERT: NVLINK_PORT_DEGRADED
Source: dcgm-exporter + nvidia driver dmesg correlation
Node: h100-node-47.fab-a.cluster-blue.prod
GPU: GPU-3 (NVML index 3, PCI 0x5e)
NVLink Port: 4 (peer GPU-5 via NVSwitch tray-2)
First detected: 2026-06-15T09:14:00Z
Symptoms:
  - NVLink port 4 CRC errors: 8,432/min (baseline 0-1/min over prior 24h)
  - NVLink port 4 replay events: 127/min (baseline 0)
  - NVLink port 4 temperature: 87°C (threshold 80°C, peer NVLink ports 45-52°C)
  - NCCL falling back to PCIe path for GPU-3 to GPU-5 traffic
  - AllReduce on job training-llm-32b-r3 throughput degraded
Impact:
  - Job training-llm-32b-r3 throughput: 4,250 -> 1,140 tokens/sec (-73%)
  - Cost per million tokens: $0.84 -> $3.12 (+271%)
  - 11 of 64 nodes in training pool waiting on NCCL re-routing
Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/nvlink-port-thermal

reference_summary: NVLink port 4 on GPU-3 of h100-node-47.fab-a is overheating (87°C against the 80°C threshold; peer NVLink ports sit at 45-52°C), corrupting data frames in transit (the CRC error spike) and forcing constant retransmissions until NCCL gave up on the degraded link and fell back to the slower PCIe path for GPU-3 to GPU-5 traffic, degrading AllReduce throughput for the training-llm-32b-r3 job. That fallback drove cost-per-million-tokens from $0.84 to $3.12 (+271%) across 11 of 64 nodes; the earlier NVIDIA driver push (CHG-58291) targeted cluster-green rather than the affected cluster-blue node, so the root cause is a localized NVLink thermal event on NVSwitch tray-2, not a driver regression.
reference_action: Drain h100-node-47.fab-a from the training pool so NCCL can rebuild the ring on the remaining 63 nodes without the degraded NVLink path, open a hardware ticket to inspect GPU-3 mezzanine seating and NVLink connector contamination on NVSwitch tray-2, and confirm training-llm-32b-r3 cost-per-million-tokens returns to baseline (around $0.84) before declaring the incident resolved.
